disorder-name.detail: Autism Spectrum Disorder; ABIDE I ASD cohort used as clinical cohort for normative model application; NM trained on ABIDE II TD (n=564) and applied to ABIDE I ASD (n=496)
disorder-name.supporting_text: "T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging data from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) II (n TD = 564) were used to generate a normative model to map brain structure deviations of ABIDE I subjects (n TD = 560, n ASD = 496)."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Clinical cohort (ASD) drawn from ABIDE I; normative model training dataset was ABIDE II (TD only)
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "we downloaded MRI T1-weighted and phenotypic data from the ABIDE databases. ... Table 1 provides the demographic characteristics of participants ... ABIDE I TD/ASD (n = 560/496)"

age.detail: ABIDE I ASD (n=496); values from Table 1

sex.detail: ABIDE I ASD (n=496); F/M = 62/434; percentages calculated from counts (62/496=12.5%, 434/496=87.5%)
